answer_1.quote: Conditional text generation is the task of generating a sequence of text given a specific prompt. Pre-trained generative LMs such as GPT-3 and T5 have been shown to be highly effective at generating high-quality text conditioned on various prompt inputs.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic queries given documents from the original training data

answer_2.quote: We compute measures of similarity between the synthetic data generated by the DP-trained T5 models against the original data. Since the synthetic data is one-to-one generated from the original data, we can compute BLEU scores to evaluate similarity. We also compute the MAUVE scores, shown to be more capable of comparing similarity of text distributions.
